reviews.text: Hello, Gladys Fernández, thank you for your rating.
Thank you very much for your feedback, Fran Gavilan.
Super professional, delighted with the way they treat my dog.

Very professional and excellent service.
Very satisfied.
This is my go-to clinic for all my dogs. They take care of everything, from minor issues to major problems, and they're always very caring and give excellent advice. I completely trust them!

I stumbled across this clinic a few years ago, and what a fortunate coincidence it was! Everyone I've met here clearly has a deep devotion to their work and an undeniable passion and dedication to animals. This gives you great peace of mind because you know they'll treat your pets as if they were their own. The service is impeccable, both the veterinary and grooming departments. I highly recommend them in every way.

Thank you so much for taking such good care of our pets.
It has specific devices, it's very effective, my dogs have improved their health

Very friendly and approachable.
Excellent professionals.
Thank you for your positive review, Esther Sanz Gallego
Nino left very happy

After a few days since Tolin's departure, I want to thank Alberto, Javier, and Gema for their kindness, professionalism, and wonderful conduct.

I'm very sad but very grateful. Thank you from the bottom of my heart 🖤

A fantastic clinic!! Wonderful professionals, Clara and Javier are lovely. We went with my dog ​​Hunter and left delighted; they treated him wonderfully and cured everything. They treated him with great care and affection, and even gave him antibiotics without him noticing. Excellent value for money.
Highly recommended!!! I won't be going to any other vet.
Hello, Alicia Ares de Blas, thank you for your rating.
Thank you for taking the time to rate us so positively, Jk.
I want to thank the professionals who were very good

They're fantastic, they explain things brilliantly and clearly. I've already recommended them and it's always been a success. They helped us with our Spanish Water Dog's allergies and he's doing great. They always make time for you whenever you need them. Even though we've moved to Colmenar Viejo, it's still worth coming to this veterinary center. Thank you so much for everything!

Everything is fine for healthy animals, but if they have any illness, look for a more professional place. They administer treatments just in case, and sometimes the animals end up getting sicker... I don't recommend it.
I'm happy with this clinic, they do a great job and the staff are friendly ☺️
I take my dog ​​there and had her spayed. I'm very happy with the care and treatment. The operation went great. I also take her to their grooming salon, which is excellent. 100% recommended.
Thank you for your very positive rating, Amelia Pino
Hello, José de la Puente Gil, we appreciate your feedback.
Excellent clinic, Alberto and his assistant are fantastic, they treat your pet with great care. For me, a 10/10 clinic

My daughter Celina and I are also very happy; they have taken excellent care of our pet, Lucas. Besides suffering from frequent vomiting and diarrhea, Lucas has a liver tumor and dilated cardiomyopathy.
They are helping him have a good quality of life in his final days, which are the most difficult for both our pets and their owners. Alberto and Javier have given us excellent advice on food, medication, and overall well-being. We will always be grateful.

I couldn't be more grateful to them. I've been going to them practically since I adopted my two dogs.

They are exceptional professionals, always serious but with such warmth and professionalism.

I want to highlight the amazing work they did on my Rem, who had a lump on his paw—a difficult area for a scar to heal properly. They did an incredible job.

Otto and Rem are always happy to be with them, and I'm so grateful to have such wonderful veterinarians so close to home.

Thank you so much, guys. You truly care about our animals.

I couldn't be more grateful. I called them feeling quite distressed, explaining what was happening with my dog, Candela, who had been at another clinic for a few months and wasn't showing any improvement. After speaking with Alberto and Javi, I left feeling much more at ease. I saw that they are truly professional and have earned my complete trust. I wholeheartedly recommend them; they were a wonderful discovery, and I am so incredibly grateful!

We arrived with Candela because she'd been suffering from gastric problems for two months, and all they were doing was taking our money while Candela wasn't improving. We came to this clinic, and Alberto saw us. He's a real expert, as he prescribed a diet supplemented with a special pâté, and she seems to be doing better without us having to pay more at each visit without seeing any progress. You have definitely earned my complete trust, and you will certainly be my go-to clinic. Thank you so much for everything 😊

After visiting several veterinary clinics with my adopted dog, who was having some health issues, I was recommended this clinic, and it was absolutely the right choice. Their professionalism, the calming atmosphere they exude, and their accurate diagnoses mean I haven't trusted any other veterinarian since. 100% recommended.
Very professional and friendly. They always explain everything to me, the service is very personal, and they're also very affectionate with my dog, Pepa. The best.

I am extremely disappointed with the care my dog ​​Vera received at this clinic. She has always had delicate teeth because she was an abandoned dog, and a few years ago, she had several teeth extracted at another clinic.
In February 2024 (and again in October of that year), she underwent dental treatments at this clinic. They left her with a molar that had bone loss and gum recession. Two months later, they talked about extracting it, then said it could be kept without any problem... Constant changes of opinion. The result? Two weeks ago, that molar became infected and had to be treated by one of the best dentists in the country. Other diseased teeth were also found in her mouth, left by Alberto, which could have caused something very serious, including teeth with significant bone loss and even tooth resorption! (I should add that these dental cleanings at CV Don Quijote were performed WITHOUT PRE-OPERATIVE PREPARATION, with the inherent risks that entails.)
If you lack the necessary dental knowledge, call a qualified dentist, but do not perform the procedures yourselves, because you are playing with the health of our animals!
They attract clients with low prices, but sometimes cheap ends up being expensive. We will attempt to take action through the Veterinary Association to ensure this doesn't go unpunished.
I absolutely do not recommend them; it's very sad to encounter veterinarians like this.

I took one of my cats there for an ear problem, and they not only treated him wonderfully, but they were also quick, patient, and caring. I highly recommend them for their price, service, and dedication. A 10 out of 10!

It's a trustworthy clinic with an outstanding team.
They are highly professional, instill confidence, and support you throughout the entire process. Our dog has lived with them for almost 14 years and couldn't have been in better hands.
Excellent and timely care. Our pet is still undergoing treatment and everything is going well.
Excellent professionals and very kind. They've been our go-to vet for years, for everything from checkups to an emergency operation our cat needed.
Excellent service from both the staff and Gemma!
Excellent vet. They treat my cat very well.
I've only had one appointment at the groomer's and it was excellent. The next one is on the 13th in the morning, groomer and vet appointment.
I've known them for over 15 years and I assure you there's no better place for our pets... I live abroad now and I'm still a loyal customer... Spectacular service and undeniable professionalism!
The best vets in the area. I'd say Moka loves going, but that's not true... we do!
They are 100% professional!! Besides that, they are wonderful people. Thank you so much, Alberto!
This clinic is fantastic! The veterinarians are very friendly and highly competent. If you have a pet, don't hesitate, take them to this clinic.
I come there whenever I need to. We really like the service.

We took our three-and-a-half-month-old puppy to this clinic. We came on the recommendation of my mother, who had taken her cat there some time ago. We were truly delighted. The professionals at this clinic treated us with immense kindness, explained everything about our dog, and gave us lots of advice, which was much appreciated as it was our first time owning a dog. It's clear they work with genuine care and prioritize the animal's health above all else. We will definitely be back ;)

Good afternoon, we don't live near this veterinary clinic, but I can tell you that the people there are incredibly kind. They've donated so many things for us to take back to Valencia so we can help the animals there, who also need it. Thank you so much!

Thank you so much for your support of the animals affected by the DANA storm in Valencia! The medicine you so generously donated will be a huge help right now. We'll be delivering it on Thursday to the collection center set up at the Benimàmet "Ricardo Ten" Sports Center, north of Valencia. Sending you all a big hug!

Excellent! Very empathetic, careful, and thorough veterinarians.
Highly recommended.

I'm not going to say anything against the professionals who work at this clinic.
But I do have to say something about them: their lack of empathy towards the families of the animals they care for. I don't know if my cat Mia died because her time had come... or because they didn't realize the extent of what was wrong with her lungs. Every 10 days she had an X-ray, antibiotics, and corticosteroids. I don't know why they weren't able to face my daughter. At least to say, "I'm so sorry for the loss of your kitten." I had constantly told my daughter to get a CT scan or an MRI, but you never agreed, and then the last time she went, you said she might have a tumor? I don't know you personally at all, but I didn't like the way you treated me. The lack of time you have to at least offer condolences to the person who lost their pet—I don't say "pet" because I don't like to use that term. I told my daughter a long time ago to take her to a good clinic, especially one where there are people who understand and care about the loss of a loved one. My experience with you was an emergency admission, and you never once contacted me to ask what had happened. My daughter trusted you completely, and you have left a very bad taste in my mouth and an immense pain in my heart.
Professionalism, thoroughness. Good service.

100% recommended. I feel very reassured knowing they're in my neighborhood. They're very clear and straightforward, with reasonable prices, and they never make you do unnecessary tests. You can tell they genuinely care about the well-being of pets, and above all, they're incredibly kind.
